pages.text: The Remote Control lets you remotely access the menu of a selected block in range (in fact, more generically right-click on it). Shift-right-click on a block to add it to the remote control (up to 5 blocks can be stored). Shift-scroll to cycle between blocks. Right-click the remote control to open that block's menu.
Type /landsutilities rename_link <name> as a command to rename what the current block connection is called, and /landsutilities delete_link to delete the current block from the remote control.
